parsed.explanation: Thin dossier with no traveller-facing trans evidence: no documented criminalisation, targeting, facility or document restrictions, but also no documented acceptance of foreign documents/markers, facility or ward access, or enforcement of anti-discrimination law on gender-identity grounds. General anti-discrimination law and the 2012 visitor same-sex union are resident/climate signals showing a functioning, tolerant legal framework, not direct trans-visitor protections, and marriage equality is not a score driver. Absence of evidence in this thin record is not safety, so it cannot reach 0.65-0.85 tiers requiring documented acceptance and working remedies, but with no documented universal exposure or organised targeting it sits above 0.45-0.55.
